column6: No attesting pair: BabelStone IDS writes no katakana, so no pair of the graph can show コ against 龴. The nearest measured substitutions of 龴 are 口↔龴 (5 pairs in 2 contexts, 6 of 95 predicted pairs stated) and 匕↔龴 (1 pair, 通:𨓛).

Three written pairs show it (迭:𨒔 wikidata; 鉃:鉄 cjkvi-variants, mj-shrink-map; 雉:𨾤 cjkvi-variants, wikidata), but only 3 of the 25 pairs it predicts are stated, under the 30% agreement, so the attested table leaves it out.
